description: This file defines the ApplicationInsightsClient class for interacting with Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights service, including method annotations for various API operations.

classes.name: ApplicationInsightsClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: addWorkload
methods.description: Adds a workload to the Application Insights service.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new application in Application Insights.

methods.name: createComponent
methods.description: Creates a new component within an application.

methods.name: createLogPattern
methods.description: Creates a new log pattern for monitoring.

methods.name: describeComponent
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific component.

methods.name: describeComponentConfigurationRecommendation
methods.description: Provides configuration recommendations for a component.

methods.name: describeLogPattern
methods.description: Retrieves information about a log pattern.

methods.name: describeProblem
methods.description: Provides details about a problem instance.

methods.name: describeProblemObservations
methods.description: Lists observations related to a problem.
